% Puts every example of the IEEE Reference Guide (V 3.28.2025) next to the
% output of biblatex-ieee, so that differences can be spotted by eye.
% Vendored from biblatex-ieee by scripts/ieee-reference-guide.py of generator-latex-template; do not edit.
% Built by the reference-guide job of check.yml with biblatex-ieee as distributed by TeX Live:
% latexmk -lualatex -jobname=comparison-reference-guide-biblatex comparison/reference-guide-biblatex.tex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[a4paper,margin=2cm]{geometry}
\usepackage{fontspec}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage[english]{selnolig}
\usepackage{csquotes}
\usepackage[style=ieee,backend=biber]{biblatex}
\usepackage{xurl}
\usepackage{luacode}
\usepackage{minted}
\setminted{style=friendly,fontsize=\footnotesize,breaklines,breakanywhere}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\hypersetup{hidelinks}

\addbibresource{comparison/reference-guide-biblatex.bib}

% Like \fullcite, but ends the entry as the bibliography does (final period)
\makeatletter
\DeclareCiteCommand{\bibentry}
  {\defcounter{maxnames}{\blx@maxbibnames}}
  {\usedriver{\DeclareNameAlias{sortname}{default}}{\thefield{entrytype}}%
   \finentry}
  {}
  {}
\makeatother

% \bibsource{<key>}: the entry's lines of the .bib file, found by its key
\begin{luacode*}
  local bibfile = "comparison/reference-guide-biblatex.bib"
  local lines = {}
  for line in io.lines(kpse.find_file(bibfile)) do lines[#lines + 1] = line end
  function bibsource(key)
    for first, line in ipairs(lines) do
      if line:sub(1, 1) == "@" and line:find("{" .. key .. ",", 1, true) then
        for last = first + 1, #lines do
          if lines[last] == "}" then
            tex.sprint(string.format(
              "\\inputminted[firstline=%d,lastline=%d]{bibtex}{%s}",
              first, last, bibfile))
            return
          end
        end
      end
    end
    tex.error("bibsource: entry '" .. key .. "' not found in " .. bibfile)
  end
\end{luacode*}
\newcommand*{\bibsource}[1]{\directlua{bibsource("\luaescapestring{#1}")}}

% Each example as rows of three columns: number, label, content.
% The content is a top-aligned minipage, so it wraps within its column.
\newlength{\guidenumwidth}
\newlength{\guidelabelwidth}
\settowidth{\guidenumwidth}{[000]\quad}
\settowidth{\guidelabelwidth}{\textbf{biblatex-ieee:}\quad}
\newcommand{\guiderow}[3]{%
  \par\noindent
  \makebox[\guidenumwidth][l]{#1}%
  \makebox[\guidelabelwidth][l]{\textbf{#2}}%
  \begin{minipage}[t]{\dimexpr\linewidth-\guidenumwidth-\guidelabelwidth\relax}
    \raggedright #3%
  \end{minipage}\par
  \smallskip
}

% \guide{<key>}{<text of the guide>}
% One unbreakable box per example, so that a page break never splits it
\newcommand{\guide}[2]{%
  \par\noindent
  \begin{minipage}{\linewidth}
    \guiderow{\cite{#1}}{Guide:}{#2}%
    \guiderow{}{biblatex-ieee:}{\bibentry{#1}}%
    \guiderow{}{BibTeX:}{\bibsource{#1}}%
  \end{minipage}\par
  \medskip
}
\newenvironment{examples}{\par}{\par}

\title{IEEE Reference Guide examples typeset with \textsf{biblatex-ieee}}
\date{\today}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

Each example of the
\href{https://journals.ieeeauthorcenter.ieee.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/IEEE_Reference_Guide.pdf}{IEEE Reference Guide, V 3.28.2025}
is shown twice: first as given in the guide (\enquote{Guide}; plain text, the
guide's italics are not reproduced), then as typeset by \textsf{biblatex-ieee}
(\enquote{biblatex-ieee}) from the entry of \texttt{comparison/reference-guide-biblatex.bib}
printed below it.
Entry types biblatex has no IEEE driver for (legal citations, government
documents) are entered as \texttt{@misc}.
The complete reference list follows at the end.
